title: A service with injected dependencies
hints: borrow: const book = await books.findById(bookId); throw new Error("book not found") when it is null, and "book is already borrowed" when book.borrowedBy !== null.
The due date: clock() + 14 * DAY. Save a copy: const updated = { ...book, borrowedBy: memberId, dueAt: ... }; await books.save(updated); return updated;
giveBack: const delay = clock() - book.dueAt. When delay > 0 the fee is Math.ceil(delay / DAY) * 50, and you call await notify(memberId, `late fee: ${fee}`).
